[[File:Nysillin.png|thumb|right|250px|Nysillin plants growing on Felucia]]
{{Quote|They're growing healing herbs.''"<br />"''Nysillin, I believe, one of the most valuable crops in the galaxy.|Ahsoka Tano and Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=HealingHerbs-BH.flac|<ref name="BH">{{TCW|Bounty Hunters (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''Nysillin''' was a healing herb grown on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] and known to be harvested by [[Casiss/Legends|Casiss]] and his [[Akira/Legends|farming community]] at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|band]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] led by [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] harassed the village into giving them the valuable crop, leading Casiss to hire a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to drive off the pirates.<ref name="BH" /> Later, the [[Nuro pirates/Legends|Nuro Pirates]] led by [[Yorn Nuro]] started a [[Nysillin farm (Nuro Pirates)|nysillin farm]], fighting against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]].<ref name="TCWA">{{TCWA|loc=Felucia}}</ref> During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], [[Impact (spice)|Impact]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] was derived from nysillin.<ref name="Fly Casual">''[[Fly Casual]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Nysillin first appeared in "[[Bounty Hunters (episode)|Bounty Hunters]]," the seventeenth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''. The episode was directed by [[Steward Lee]], written by [[Carl Ellsworth]], and first aired on [[April 2]], [[2010]]. There is a discrepancy in the episode on what the plant was called. On entering the farm and seeing the plants, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] called it "nysillin," but Casiss called their work "sillum farming." It is possible that "sillum" is a slang term. Another aspect is that in the episode Obi-Wan refers to Nysillin is "''One of the most valuable crops in the galaxy''" yet the farmer Casiss refers to it as a "Meager trade."<ref name="BH" />

According to the episode guide, Nysillin is farmed in the "spice farming village,"<ref name="BH EG">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode217.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Bounty Hunters}}</ref> but in the episode itself it's a "healing herb."<ref name="BH" />
